name: featured-dithering
title: Dithering Photo Card
description: Image dithering shader (via @paper-design/shaders-react) — supports random + Bayer 2x2/4x4/8x8 patterns, custom 2-3 color palettes, configurable color steps, and an originalColors mode that samples directly from the image. Includes the shared title overlay API (titleText/titlePosition/titleSize/titleColor).
